methods.description: Identify both complete diagonals, substitute A=xy/2 and halve their product with square units; side lengths are not needed.
Add split parts or use marked equal halves/worded relationships to obtain the complete diagonals before A=xy/2.
Express both known diagonals in the same length unit before applying A=xy/2; square that unit for area.
Explain that side and perpendicular height are not diagonal lengths and cannot be substituted as x/y in A=xy/2.
